scripts.dev: npm run build -w server && concurrently -n client,electron -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev:wait -w electron"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3 && cd electron && set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false&& npx electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.typecheck: npm exec -w client -- tsc --noEmit && npm exec -w server -- tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test -w client && npm run test -w server
